title: 小民居
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Re-render this single Yuan northern China building sprite to correct its CAMERA and rectangular ground proportions. Keep the same muted realistic matte materials, age, fine details, upper-left light, short lower-right shadow and anonymous Yuan subject. The current ground is too steep. Replace projection with exact orthographic DIMETRIC yaw45 pitch30, NOT standard 35.264 isometric. Both ground diagonals are shallower: exact screen slopes +0.5 and -0.5, screen angle 26.565 degrees. Footprint is 6m by 5m. From the leftmost ground corner to the bottom/front ground corner, horizontal run must be 1.2000 times the horizontal run from bottom/front to rightmost ground corner. Keep all parallel lines parallel; make this thin ground-contact rectangle very clear, not a thick raised base. Build the walls and roofs upright above that corrected plane. The source image angles must NOT be preserved. TRUE RGBA TRANSPARENT background, alpha0 outside object; 10 percent empty margin every side, whole roof and base visible. No text, grid, dimensions, labels, people or additional surroundings.
selection_note: 选第二候选：灰瓦土墙主体完整，双轴与占地比改善。
